# Cursor changelog — captured 2026-08-10
# https://cursor.com/changelog

Newest entry is still **Aug 3, 2026 — Google Workspace Plugins** (reported 2026-08-07): agents get
read/write/act access to Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Docs and Sheets through Google's remote MCP
servers, installed from the Cursor Marketplace. No entries dated Aug 4-10.

Prior, all previously covered: Jul 29 iPad support (PR review, inbox, Bitbucket + Azure DevOps SCM);
Jul 28 Cursor Start regional plan (India); Jul 22 Cursor Router (Cost / Balance / Intelligence modes
with per-team admin controls); Jul 17 Slack integration improvements.

## NEW SOURCE DRIFT (2026-08-10)
The sources.json Cursor docs URL `https://docs.cursor.com` now returns a **308 cross-host redirect to
`https://cursor.com/docs`** (WebFetch does not auto-follow cross-host redirects). Fetched
successfully at the new URL. Documentation sections:
  - Agent — overview, agents window, review, planning (Plan Mode), prompting, debugging, design mode
  - Customize — plugins, rules, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP
  - Cloud Agents — setup, builds, capabilities, best practices, automations, Bugbot, security agents,
    PR routing
  - Integrations — GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Jira, Linear, Notion + 6 more
  - SDK & CLI — TypeScript, Python, bridge tools, CLI
  - Teams & Enterprise — admin controls and organizational features
Models listed: Claude Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Fable 5, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Cursor Composer, Grok;
context windows up to 1M with "AgentThinking".
Nothing dated August 2026 in the docs and nothing above the watching-tier bar (only major NEW
capabilities qualify). **Recommend updating the Cursor docs URL in sources.json.**

Updated: 2026-08-10 — no change (one new source redirect recorded).
